context: The scene is set in a creche/monastery around a recently-activated planecaster; the device flares to life and projects Vlaakith as a huge, astral hologram while the area still reels from violent events (the Lance firing, explosions, wounded bystanders), so tensions are high. Vlaakith speaks with an imperious, unnerving tone and declares there is a prisoner inside the artifact who must be killed for the safety of the gith, then activates the planecaster so it can be used to open the Orpheus artefact. The Inquisitor (Ch'r'ai W'wargaz) and Lae'zel kneel and address her like a queen, which explains their deference and the authoritarian tone of the exchange. The player can comply, hand over the artefact, or refuse — refusal can provoke Vlaakith to order the inquisitor to kill or hunt the player (and may affect Lae'zel’s loyalties), and in some branches the player is teleported into the Astral Prison.
